name: 90/90 Hip Rotation
description: Seated hip internal/external rotation flow — comprehensive hip mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor with one leg bent 90° in front (shin perpendicular to torso, thigh forward) and the other leg bent 90° to the side. From this position, rotate both knees to flip to the opposite 90/90 position. Flow slowly back and forth.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
description: Dynamic 90/90 hip rotation flow — opens internal and external rotation at the hip for guard retention, kicks, and stance changes.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with both legs in 90/90 position. Keeping knees low, fluidly rotate the knees and hips to the other side (transition through upright). Ten switches. Add forward folds over each front leg for depth.

name: 90/90 Shoulder Stretch
description: Shoulder flexor stretch targeting posterior capsule tightness common in swimmers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side with bottom arm at 90° (upper arm out, forearm up). Use the top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor. Hold 30-45 seconds. Switch sides.

name: Aikido Tenkan Pivot Flow
description: Continuous pivot-turn flow — foundational aikido ukemi and blending footwork.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in natural stance. Pivot 180 deg on the lead foot, step through, pivot again. Continuous smooth rotations for 2-3 min.

name: Ankle CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
description: Active ankle mobility sweep in every direction — builds full ROM and joint resilience, key for ankle-injury-heavy sports.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or supine, extend one leg. Slowly draw the largest possible circle with the foot, moving through dorsiflexion, inversion, plantarflexion, and eversion. Keep the knee still. 5 per direction per side.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Band Mobilization
description: Band-distracted ankle dorsiflexion — restores dorsiflexion critical for squatting, cutting, and landing.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a heavy band low and loop it around the front of the ankle. Half-kneel with the banded ankle forward, band pulling the tibia back. Drive the knee forward over the toes, holding 2-3 sec. 10-15 per side.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobility (Knee-to-Wall)
description: Closed-chain ankle mobility — the range the front foot needs to sit into a telemark lunge or ski boot.
instructions_excerpt: Stand facing a wall. Place one foot a few inches back with heel planted. Drive the knee forward to the wall without lifting the heel. Work the knee past the toe. 10 reps per side.

name: Ankle Rockers (Lateral)
description: Dynamic lateral ankle mobilization — ankle rockers in frontal plane for lateral court push-off.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet wider than hips. Shift weight to one side, rocking the far-side foot onto the outer edge of the shoe while the near-side ankle dorsiflexes over the toes. Flow side-to-side. 10 per side.

name: Bench Arch Thoracic Mobility
description: Thoracic-extension mobility drill on a bench — maintains the bench-press arch without lumbar overload.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench with feet planted. Slowly arch back, letting the T-spine extend over the edge of the bench. Reach arms overhead. Hold 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply. Sit back up.

name: Bretzel Stretch
description: Side-lying combined hip-flexor and t-spine rotation stretch — addresses paddler posture in one move.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side, bottom leg straight, top leg bent with foot anchored in opposite hand. Other hand grabs the top knee. Rotate the upper torso open, looking over the shoulder. Hold 30-45 seconds. Switch.

name: Cat-Cow Extension Hold
description: Active spinal extension hold at the top of cat-cow — counteracts prone-paddling flexion loads.
instructions_excerpt: From a quadruped cat-cow, move into full extension (head up, belly down) and hold 3-5 seconds. Breathe. Return to neutral. Repeat.

name: Cat-Cow Flow
description: Spinal articulation flow — the basic warm-up move for spinal mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Start in quadruped. Inhale and drop the belly, lift the chest and tailbone (cow). Exhale and round the spine, tuck tailbone, drop the head (cat). Flow slowly 8-12 reps.

name: Cat-Cow Flow (Slow)
description: Slow segmental spinal flexion/extension — daily spinal health flow for yogis and desk workers.
instructions_excerpt: Tabletop. Inhale: drop belly, lift chest and tail (cow). Exhale: round spine, tuck tail, drop head (cat). Move one vertebra at a time.

name: Cossack Lunge with Reach
description: Cossack squat adding a same-side arm reach overhead — lateral hip mobility with thoracic rotation for surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Drop into a cossack squat on one side. At the bottom, reach the bent-side arm overhead and laterally open. Stand up and alternate sides.

name: Couch Stretch (Hip Flexor)
description: Deep hip flexor stretch — addresses the sitting-stuck anterior pelvis.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel in front of a wall or couch. Place one shin and the top of the foot against the wall/couch vertically. Step the other foot forward into a lunge, keeping torso upright. Squeeze the glute of the back leg and tuck the pelvis posteriorly to deepen the stretch. Hold 60-90 seconds per side.

name: Couch Stretch Active (Hip Flexor)
description: Active hip-flexor lengthening with glute drive — unlocks the hip flexors shortened by sitting and sprinting.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel with one foot elevated behind on a couch/bench, shin vertical. Torso upright. Actively squeeze the glute of the rear leg while tucking the pelvis. Hold 30-45 sec, release, repeat.

name: Dance Spinal Wave
description: Isolated spinal wave — articulation drill for contemporary, hip-hop, pole.
instructions_excerpt: Stand wide. Initiate from the tailbone, wave up vertebra by vertebra to the crown of the head. Reverse the wave back down. 6-8 cycles.

name: Dancer's Lateral Lunge with Reach
description: Lateral lunge with torso reach — lateral mobility + rotation for Latin and ballroom dance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand wide. Shift weight to one side into a lateral lunge while the opposite arm reaches overhead to the lunge side. Reverse smoothly.

name: Deep Forward Lunge Rotation
description: Deep lunge with torso rotation — common for bow hunting stalks and golf end-of-swing follow-through.
instructions_excerpt: Step into a deep forward lunge, then rotate the torso over the front knee. Hold 2-3s. Alternate. 6-8 per side.

name: Deep Squat Hold (Prayer)
description: End-range squat hold — hip, ankle, and adductor mobility for guard retention and striker stance.
instructions_excerpt: Drop into the deepest squat you can with flat feet. Place elbows inside knees, hands in a prayer position, and gently push knees outward. Hold 30-90 seconds while breathing.

name: Downward Dog
description: Full-chain posterior stretch + inversion — warmup or recovery staple.
instructions_excerpt: From hands and knees, tuck toes and press hips up and back into an inverted "V". Press firmly through the hands, let the heels sink toward the floor, and lengthen the spine. Hold 20-30 seconds.

name: Drop-Knee Turn Simulation
description: Dryland drop-knee turn — trains the knee drop and lower leg drive used by surfers and longboarders in turns.
instructions_excerpt: From a surf stance, drop the back knee low to the floor (over the back heel), then drive back up. Keep the front leg strong and bent.

name: Foam Roller T-Spine Extension
description: Prone supported thoracic extension over a foam roller — frees the T-spine for the front rack, bench arch, and overhead positions.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with a foam roller across the mid-back (under the shoulder blades). Hands behind the head supporting the neck. Exhale and arch over the roller for 2-3 breaths. Shift the roller up 1 inch, repeat. Cover mid-T-spine only.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
description: Foam roller T-spine extensions — reverses the flexed posture from long matches / desk work.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with a foam roller across the mid-back. Hands behind the head or crossed over chest. Let the upper body arch back over the roller. Roll up 1-2" and repeat. 8-10 segments up the T-spine.

name: Frog Stretch (Adductor Opener)
description: Deep adductor stretch — essential mobility drill for dancers, gymnasts, movement athletes.
instructions_excerpt: On hands and knees, widen the knees as far as comfortable; shins parallel to each other. Lower hips back toward heels until you feel deep adductor stretch. Hold 60-90 seconds.

name: Groin Stretch Active (Frog Rock)
description: Quadruped adductor mobilization — restores adductor range for soccer, hockey, and grappling athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Quadruped with knees wide, toes flexed. Rock hips back toward the heels until a firm stretch. Rock forward slightly and repeat. 8-12 rocks.

name: Hip 90/90 with Transitions
description: Dynamic 90/90 hip flows — hip rotator mobility for skaters, dancers, yogis.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with one leg bent 90° in front, the other 90° to the side. Lift both knees and rotate to the opposite side. Flow back and forth for 8-10 reps per side.

name: Hip CARs
description: Single-leg hip rotation through full ROM — restores hip health in grapplers whose hips spend long periods in compressed ranges.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall next to a support. Lift one knee to hip height. Rotate the knee out to the side, extend the leg back, then return to start. Reverse. 3-5 per direction per leg.

name: Hip-Rotation Open/Close Mobility
description: Quadruped or standing hip-rotation drill — unlocking golf and disc-golf hip turns.
instructions_excerpt: Quadruped: alternate internal and external rotation of one hip 8-10 reps per side. Slow and controlled.

name: Jefferson Curl
description: Loaded slow spinal flexion with a light weight — builds tissue resilience for the repeated flexion of prone paddling.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall on a box holding a light DB or kettlebell. Starting from the neck, slowly roll down vertebra by vertebra, letting the weight hang. Reverse slowly. Load light.

name: Jefferson Curl Standing (Unloaded)
description: Unloaded spinal roll-down — gentle segmental flexion for yoga and dance warm-ups.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Tuck chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time. Let arms hang. Reverse the roll slowly from the tailbone up.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch — essential recovery move for kayakers and rowers who sit flexed for hours.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel, back foot on mat. Tuck the pelvis slightly, drive the hips forward until a stretch is felt in the front of the rear hip. Hold 30-45 seconds per side.

name: Kneeling Hip-Flexor Stretch (Long Hold)
description: Long-hold hip-flexor stretch for riders and anyone who sits long hours. Opens the front of the hip.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward (90/90). Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg and gently shift hips forward until a stretch is felt in the front hip. Hold 60-90 seconds per side.

name: Latin Hip-Figure-8 Drill
description: Isolated hip-figure-8 pattern — ballroom/Latin-dance specific hip articulation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand neutral, feet hip-width. Trace a figure-8 with hips in the horizontal plane for 60 sec. Switch direction.

name: Neck CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
description: Slow, full-ROM neck circles under active control — recovery-level mobility for the neck after grappling or sparring.
instructions_excerpt: Stand or sit tall. Slowly rotate the head through its full range of motion — flexion, side, extension, other side. Move at ~3-5s per quadrant. 3-5 rotations each direction.

name: Open Book (Thoracic Rotation)
description: Side-lying T-spine rotation — isolates thoracic from lumbar.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on your side with knees bent 90° and stacked, a foam roller or pillow between the knees. Extend both arms in front at shoulder height, palms together. Keeping knees stacked on the pillow, open the top arm across the body to the opposite side, following with the eyes. Hold 2s. Return.

name: Pigeon Pose
description: Deep external-rotation hip stretch — releases piriformis and glute-med tightness that contributes to low-back and knee issues.
instructions_excerpt: From plank, bring one knee forward toward the same-side wrist, shin angled across. Extend the back leg straight behind. Lower chest toward the floor over the forward shin. Hold 60-90 sec per side.

name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
description: Kneeling T-spine rotation with hand on head — opens the thoracic spine for racquet swing follow-through.
instructions_excerpt: On hands and knees, place one hand behind the head, elbow out. Rotate the elbow down under the body, then up toward the ceiling, leading with the elbow. Look where the elbow goes. 8 per side.

name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation
description: Thoracic rotation from a quadruped position — active t-spine mobility for rotational paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Quadruped, one hand behind head. Rotate the elbow down toward the opposite wrist, then open up toward the ceiling. 8-10 per side.

name: Runner Lunge with Reach (Dynamic)
description: Deep lunge flow — opens hip flexors and adds thoracic rotation.
instructions_excerpt: Step into a deep forward lunge. Place hands on the floor inside the front foot. Reach the inside-arm up to the ceiling, rotating through the thorax. Return. Alternate.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
description: Wall slide — scap upward-rotation drill and shoulder flexion mobility for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with back against a wall, arms in goalpost position. Slowly slide the arms overhead, keeping the forearms and low back in contact with the wall. Return.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
description: Isolated T-spine rotation — golf-specific mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench or floor cross-legged with hands behind head. Rotate the torso as far as possible to one side, keeping hips square. Pause. Return. Alternate.

name: Senior-Golf Half-Swing Mobility
description: Half-swing with emphasis on thoracic rotation — age-friendly golf swing builder.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in golf posture. Half-swing (waist to waist) 10-12 times per side focusing only on T-spine rotation. Keep lower body quiet.

name: Shinbox to Stand (Get-Up Mobility)
description: Shinbox (90/90) to standing transition — hip mobility and strength flow that translates directly to standing up from the ground in a scramble.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in a 90/90 shinbox. Plant the back hand and drive through the front leg to come to a single-leg stand. Lower back through the same path. 3-5 per side, flowing slowly.

name: Shoulder CARs
description: Controlled Articular Rotations — full-range active shoulder mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall with one arm at the side. Keep ribs down and abs tight. Slowly draw the biggest possible circle with the arm: forward-up-overhead-back-down. Then reverse. Move slowly, prioritizing ROM at every point. 3-5 slow circles each direction per arm.

name: Shoulder Flossing with Band
description: Banded shoulder dislocates with isolation — shoulder joint health for gymnasts and yogis.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light band wide overhead. Rotate arms slowly from front to overhead to behind the body, then reverse. Keep arms straight. 8-10 cycles.

name: Sleeper Stretch
description: Side-lying shoulder internal rotation stretch — opens the posterior capsule that paddlers chronically tighten.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side, bottom shoulder and arm bent 90°. With the top hand, gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor. Hold 30-45 seconds. Switch sides.

name: Sleeper Stretch Flow
description: Dynamic version of the posterior-capsule stretch — targets glenohumeral internal rotation deficit (GIRD) common in serve-dominant athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side, bottom shoulder under body, upper arm at 90° shoulder flexion, forearm vertical. Use the top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor for a 5-sec hold. Release. Repeat 8-10 times per side as a flow.

name: Spider-Man Walk
description: Walking lunge with T-spine rotation — full-body warm-up essential for team-sport athletes.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, step into a deep lunge. Place the same-side hand inside the lead foot. Rotate the opposite hand up to the sky. Return hand, step back, and repeat on the other side. 5-8 per side.

name: Standing Splits Prep (Dancer's Splits)
description: Active standing split progression — hamstring/hip-flexor mobility for dancers and martial artists.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Lift the free leg forward/up as high as possible actively (no hands). Hold 5-10 seconds. Lower. Repeat to the side and then back.

name: Sun Salutation Flow (Yoga Warmup)
description: Surya Namaskar chain — warm-up and mobility flow core to any yoga practice.
instructions_excerpt: Cycle: mountain pose, forward fold, half-lift, low push-up, upward dog, downward dog, step forward, fold, return. 5-8 full rounds.

name: Supine Snow Angel (Shoulder Mobility)
description: Supine shoulder mobility sweeps — opens the shoulder for paddling, swimming, and surf paddle-out.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, arms at sides. Slowly sweep arms overhead along the floor and back. Keep low back pressed into the floor. 8-10 reps.

name: Sword-Draw Shoulder Mobility
description: Shoulder external rotation + overhead reach drill with a dowel — iaido / kendo cut prep.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a dowel behind the back with both hands. Press the dowel up and away from the body, opening the shoulders. 10-15 slow reps.

name: T-Spine Rotation with Reach
description: Side-lying thoracic rotation with arm reach — bread-and-butter for golfers' thoracic mobility.
instructions_excerpt: Side-lying, knees at 90. Open the top arm across the body, following with eyes. Hold 3s. Return. 8 per side.

name: Tai Chi Silk Reeling Circle
description: Fundamental silk-reeling circular arm pattern — tai chi coordination and structural warmup.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a wide stance. Trace a continuous figure-8 in front of the body with both arms, alternating hands, at 60-80 circles per minute. 3-5 min.

name: Thoracic Extension on Foam Roller
description: Supine foam-roller thoracic extension — reopens the upper back for overhead athletes and desk-bound rec-leaguers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with foam roller across the mid-back (bra-line). Hands support the head. Slowly extend back over the roller. Move the roller 1-2 inches up or down and repeat. Cover mid-thoracic segments.

name: Thoracic Extension over Bench / Foam Roller
description: Thoracic extension stretch — restores the rotational upper back a striker needs for hooks and a grappler needs for posture.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel in front of a bench (or place a foam roller under mid-back). Rest elbows on the bench, hands together. Drop the chest toward the floor, feeling extension through the mid-back. Hold 30-60 seconds breathing deeply.

name: Thoracic Spine Rotation (Quadruped)
description: Classic T-spine rotation drill — opens the thorax for reach moves.
instructions_excerpt: Start in quadruped (hands under shoulders, knees under hips). Place one hand behind the head. Rotate the elbow up toward the ceiling, opening the chest. Then rotate down, threading the elbow under the opposite arm. 8-10 reps each side.

name: Thread-the-Needle (Yoga)
description: Thoracic rotation stretch from quadruped — staple yoga/movement thoracic opener.
instructions_excerpt: From tabletop, thread one arm under the other, lowering shoulder and temple to the floor. Hold 30-45 seconds. Switch sides.

name: Thread-the-Needle Reach
description: T-spine rotation drill with an active reach — opens the mid-back rotation paddlers lose over time.
instructions_excerpt: Quadruped position. Thread one arm under the opposite chest, then reach the threaded arm out to the side and up toward the ceiling, opening the chest. Return. Alternate.

name: Wall Ankle Mobility
description: Dorsiflexion drill — essential for high-stepping and deep squats.
instructions_excerpt: Stand facing a wall with one foot ~4 inches from the wall. Drive the knee forward over the toes to touch the wall without lifting the heel. Move the foot back as far as possible while still touching the wall with the knee on every rep.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
description: Multi-joint mobility flow — opens hips, T-spine, shoulders.
instructions_excerpt: Step into a deep lunge. Place both hands on the inside of the front foot. Lower the back knee and reach one arm up rotating through the thorax, looking up. Return. Repeat both sides.

name: Wrist & Joint-Lock Partner Flow
description: Slow partnered wrist/joint flow — aikido wrist and small-joint mobilization.
instructions_excerpt: With a partner, flow through wrist locks (kote-gaeshi, nikajo) at 30% resistance, focusing on kuzushi (off-balance). 5-10 min.

name: Wrist CARs / Wrist Circles
description: Full-ROM wrist mobility — essential for loaded hangs.
instructions_excerpt: Make a fist with one hand. Slowly move the fist through the full available ROM: flexion-radial-extension-ulnar and back. Make large, slow circles. Both directions. Then open the hand and repeat with spread fingers.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
description: Stretches the forearm extensors — counterpart to the flexor stretch.
instructions_excerpt: Extend one arm in front with palm down. With the other hand gently press the back of the hand down and toward the body. Hold 20-30 seconds per side.

name: Wrist Flexion/Extension Mobility
description: Four-way wrist mobility drill — essential for the front rack (clean) and overhead (jerk) positions.
instructions_excerpt: On all fours, place palms flat under shoulders, fingers forward. Slowly shift weight forward/back to stretch the wrist. Repeat with fingers pointed back, then sideways, then palms-up (backs of hands down).

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
description: Counteracts climbing grip and desk-work tightness.
instructions_excerpt: Extend one arm in front with palm up. With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward the body, stretching the forearm flexors. Hold 20-30 seconds per side. Repeat 2-3 rounds.
